findings.summary: The 'true rate limit' recipe doesn't limit the rate to RATE: with Semaphore(10), each of the 10 permits sleeps 1/RATE on its own, so throughput can reach about 10×RATE.
findings.evidence: "True rate limit: hold the permit, then `await asyncio.sleep(1/rate)`" alongside `sem = asyncio.Semaphore(10)` and `async with sem: ... await asyncio.sleep(1 / RATE)`
findings.fix: Say the achievable rate is about n/(latency + 1/RATE), so it only equals RATE with Semaphore(1). Otherwise point readers to a shared token bucket or limiter for a true req/s cap.

findings.fix: Mark the snippet 3.11+, or catch `asyncio.TimeoutError` so it works on every version.
